public.title: Path Sum II
public.description: Return all root-to-leaf paths whose values sum to target. Emit paths in left-child-before-right-child traversal order, preserving duplicate value paths. target is an integer from -1000000 to 1000000. Trees use compact breadth-first arrays: the first value is the root; each non-null node consumes the next two entries as left and right children. Null marks a missing child; trailing nulls may be omitted. Empty arrays mean no tree. Values are integers from -10000 to 10000, with at most 100 nodes.
hints: Carry the running sum and path down to leaves.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Depth-first traversal records only matching leaf paths, with left children visited first. Time is O(nodes plus output size).
